final: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT p.death_state, COUNT(*) as hof_count FROM hall_of_fame hf JOIN player p ON hf.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.death_state), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(hof_count) as avg_count FROM state_counts), above_avg AS (SELECT sc.hof_count FROM state_counts sc WHERE sc.hof_count > (SELECT avg_count FROM overall_avg)) SELECT AVG(hof_count) as average_hof_count_above_average, AVG(hof_count) - (SELECT avg_count FROM overall_avg) as average_excess_above_overall_average FROM above_avg
